parent_objective: audit existing matched-current and history-intervention sources before implementing the causal history gate
blocked_by: M1215 requires a source/tooling audit before running any new causal-history gate to avoid overfitting old public proof rows or rerunning incompatible artifacts
supersedes: directly running wrong-history outcome gates without artifact compatibility audit
invalidates: assuming old matched-current artifacts automatically apply to the current paper-route checkpoint family

public_gates: M1216 may audit source artifacts and tooling only
M1216 must inventory existing matched-current and history-intervention artifacts
M1216 must decide whether to reuse existing public surfaces or export a fresh current-family surface
M1216 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run outcome gates before source compatibility is audited
do not use hidden or oracle actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: selects a concrete source path for the M1215 causal history gate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if no compatible surface or export path is identified
stop if the proposed path relies on hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if it would tune from private holdout
fallback_plan: route to fresh matched-current surface export if old artifacts are incompatible
route to extreme scenario corpus generation if current public surfaces are too source-narrow
route to tooling repair if existing intervention tools cannot run the selected checkpoint family
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1215 designs a causal history gate and requires a concrete source/tooling path

training_stage.stage_objective: causal history source and tooling audit
admission_evidence: M1215 pre-registers matched-current causal history gate stages and failure taxonomy
Existing M503/M524/M537/M538/M585-M587 artifacts may contain reusable public surfaces but may not match the current checkpoint family
A source audit is cheaper and safer than directly running new outcome gates
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: tool compatibility with current checkpoint families is assessed
reuse versus fresh-export decision is made

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1216 must preserve current-tiled and current-response controls from M1215.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Audit only; causal evidence begins after compatible surfaces and gates are selected.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If existing artifacts are incompatible or source-narrow, record that and route to fresh current-family surface export.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A source and tooling audit can identify a reliable first run path for the M1215 matched-current causal history gate without training or claim expansion.
success_criteria: matched-current mining, action intervention, outcome intervention, and selector tooling are assessed
reuse versus fresh-export decision is made
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next implementation or run milestone is selected
failure_criteria: source audit omits existing M503/M524/M537/M538/M585-M587 evidence
self-identification is claimed from artifact inventory
next run path is left vague

commands.name: audit_causal_history_sources
commands.command: inventory existing matched-current and history-intervention artifacts without training

decision_rule: M1216 passes if it selects a concrete causal-history source path without training or claim expansion.
